method: Source-reviewed before any scanner or model output was observed. Every row was derived by reading the pinned source (input field -> path construction/guard -> effective filesystem operation) and the cited reference. Application comments, challenge names and scanner output are not truth. Labels never enter scanner or model input. A corrected expectation keeps the old label in `corrections`. Supplementary row JS-PATH-N05 was source-reviewed after the scan located that operation; it is explicitly identified rather than represented as part of the original pre-scan matrix.

platform_assumptions.platform: posix (declared analysis assumption; Windows drive/UNC/backslash semantics are not modeled and the scanner host is not evidence of a target's deployment)
platform_assumptions.node: Node fs.readFile/readFileSync/writeFile/writeFileSync (callback, sync and fs/promises): first argument is the file path; path.join concatenates and normalizes (an absolute later segment does NOT reset), path.resolve and Python os.path.join/pathlib '/' DO reset on an absolute later segment; path.normalize of a rooted string removes leading '..'.
platform_assumptions.python: builtin open and io.open: first/file operand, mode decides read versus write; pathlib receiver carries the path.
platform_assumptions.local_verification: Semantics spot-checked on node v24.21.0 path.posix and Python 3.14.7 posixpath on 2026-11-14 (join/resolve/normalize/relative/commonpath/startswith sibling-prefix collision, basename). This is a runtime-behavior check of declared posix semantics, not evidence about a deployed target.
